handbook.text: Acme employees receive 30 days of paid holiday per calendar year; unused days expire on 31 March of the following year.
Travel expenses above 500 euros need approval from the cost-centre owner before booking; receipts are uploaded to the expense tool within 14 days.
Salary bands for engineering levels L3 to L6 are reviewed every January by the compensation committee.

engineering.text: The on-call engineer acknowledges a paging alert within 15 minutes and opens an incident channel for every customer-facing outage.
Engineers on the on-call rota swap shifts before taking holiday and record the swap in the rota calendar.

handbook.text: Globex staff receive 25 days of paid holiday; up to five unused days can be carried over to the next year.
Globex laptops must use full-disk encryption and lock the screen after five minutes of inactivity.
